text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Had Laju Kebangsaan

(Pindaan) (No. 2) 2015.

 (2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 12 Februari 2015.

Pindaan Jadual

2. Perintah Had Laju Kebangsaan 1989 [P.U. (A) 18/1989], yang disebut

"Perintah ibu" dalam Perintah ini, dipinda dalam Jadual dengan menggantikan

butiran 17 dengan butiran yang berikut:

"17. Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Lebuh Raya Pantai Timur–Fasa 2

yang bermula dari kilometer 250.620 di koordinat U+88993.651000,

T+245032.711000 Grid Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO) Geosentrik

(GDM 2000) dan berakhir di kilometer 433.977 di koordinat

U+243442.227735, T+213048.376897 Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM 2000),

termasuklah Persimpangan Bertingkat Cheneh, Persimpangan Bertingkat

Cukai, Persimpangan Bertingkat Kijal, Persimpangan Bertingkat Kertih,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Paka, Persimpangan Bertingkat Kuala Dungun,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Bukit Besi, Persimpangan Bertingkat Ajil,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Telemung, Persimpangan Bertingkat

Kuala Terengganu dan jalan-jalan sambungannya.".

Peta

3. Jalan dengan had laju yang dinyatakan dalam butiran 17 Perintah ibu

ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

[Perenggan 3]

PETA LEBUH RAYA PANTAI TIMUR–FASA 2

Dibuat 9 Februari 2015

[KKR.PUU. 110-1/7/3/2 (29); PN(PU2)460/LXXIX]

 DATO' SRI LIOW TIONG LAI

 Menteri Pengangkutan

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

NATIONAL SPEED LIMIT (AMENDMENT) (NO. 2) ORDER 2015

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 69(1) of the Road Transport

Act 1987 [Act 333], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the National Speed Limit (Amendment)

(No. 2) Order 2015.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 12 February 2015.

Amendment of Schedule

2. The National Speed Limit Order 1989 [P.U. (A) 18/1989], which is referred to as

the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended in the Schedule by substituting for

item 17 the following item:

"17. The part of the road known as the East Coast Expressway–Phase 2

commencing from kilometre 250.620 at coordinates N+88993.651000,

E+245032.711000 Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO) Geocentric

(GDM 2000) Grid and ending at kilometre 433.977 at coordinates

N+243442.227735, E+213048.376897 (RSO) Geocentric (GDM 2000)

Grid, including the Cheneh Interchange, Cukai Interchange, Kijal

Interchange, Kertih Interchange, Paka Interchange, Kuala Dungun

Interchange, Bukit Besi Interchange, Ajil Interchange, Telemung

Interchange, Kuala Terengganu Interchange and its link roads.".

Map

3. The road with the speed limit as specified in item 17 of the principal Order is

shown on the map in the Schedule.
